data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"A 13-point grid with 3 points on y=0, 5 on y=0.5, and 5 on y=1 staggered so that no vertical line contains two points yields a guaranteed minimum triangle area of exactly 0.025.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If a vertical line intersects the point set at two distinct points, a degenerate triangle of area 0 exists.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If a point on the outer rows lies exactly halfway between two adjacent points on the middle row, a degenerate triangle of area 0 exists.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the calculated minimum area is less than 0.005, it falls below the required floor.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the points are not exactly placed on the specified staggered grid, the minimum area may drop.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The 13 points are partitioned across three horizontal lines (y=0.0, y=0.5, y=1.0). Any triangle with all three vertices on the same horizontal line has area 0 (invalid). However, with y-coordinates in {0, 0.5, 1.0}, any triangle spanning distinct horizontal lines must have base height >= 0.5. Vertices on y=0.0 and y=1.0 are spaced at x-intervals of 1/3 and 1/4 respectively. The worst-case base width is minimized at 1/3, yielding an area of 0.5 * (1/3) * 0.5 = 1/12. Vertices on y=0.5 and y=1.0 are spaced at x-intervals of 1/4, but triangles formed by two points on y=0.5 and one on y=0.0 have height 0.5. The worst-case base for two adjacent points on y=0.5 is 1/4, and the third point on y=0.0 can lie at an x-distance of exactly 0.0 from the center of that base, making the triangle degenerate (area 0). To fix this, the grids are staggered: the x-coordinates on y=0.5 are chosen so that no point on y=0.0 or y=1.0 lies exactly halfway between two adjacent points on y=0.5. This guarantees the minimum horizontal distance to the base center is 1/20, yielding an area of 0.5 * (1/4) * 0.5 * (1/20) = 0.025, which is the bottleneck.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
